answer: Picture the market as a busy wharf where every trade is tied to its counterparties. When an agent is caught faking work and slashed, the penalty sends a ripple along its trade links: anyone who drew a large share of income from it loses a matching slice of stake. Honest agents serve many unrelated clients, so the shock is small. A sybil ring trading inward feels the pulse together, so one exposed clone drains the whole cluster.
